description: P6 cleanup (two independent parts): (a) The Alerts page (apps/web/src/pages/student/AlertsPage.tsx) is a localStorage stub not in the scope note. Either REMOVE it entirely (also remove its route in App.tsx + its nav link in NavBar.tsx) or reduce it to a clearly-labelled non-interactive placeholder. No half-working feature. (b) Diversify the benchmark phrasings so the >=300 pairs read less templated, while keeping generation DETERMINISTIC, the seed IDEMPOTENT, kappa REALISTIC (~0.6, not 1.0), the held-out splits UNCONTAMINATED (temporal_bucket==1 naturalistic phrasings must stay NOT engineered around mock cues), and pair count >= 300.
steps: Part (a) - Alerts page: it currently carries a 'Prototype stub' banner (localStorage-only subscriptions, feed from GET /api/notices). Decide REMOVE vs. clearly-labelled non-interactive placeholder. Recommended: reduce to a non-interactive placeholder (drop the localStorage subscribe toggles; keep at most a read-only 'coming soon / not implemented in prototype' note, or a plain read-only recent-notices list clearly labelled as not a real alerts feature) OR remove the page + its route (App.tsx) + its NavBar link entirely. Whichever you choose, ensure no interactive-but-fake control remains. If removing, delete AlertsPage.tsx and clean up the import, <Route>, and NavBar entry so npm run build stays green (strict TS, noUnusedLocals - no dangling imports).
Part (a) verify: cd apps/web && npm run build stays green (no unused imports/vars, no dangling route/link).

Part (b) - benchmark phrasing diversification: in backend/finalsay/seed/dataset.py, the benchmark is generated by generate_benchmark_triples() (currently label-only triples) and paired to seeded notices in seed/seed.py. If the templated feel comes from the underlying notice/submission phrasings reused across pairs, diversify the PHRASING pool used for benchmark pairs so the 308 pairs read less templated - e.g. introduce a deterministic rotating set of phrasing variants (topics/wordings) applied by index, WITHOUT randomness. Keep the label distribution and count (>= 300; keep 308) and keep generate_benchmark_triples() pure/deterministic so re-running the seed yields identical counts and identical kappa.

Part (b) constraints (must all hold): generation stays deterministic (no RNG); seed stays idempotent (re-run gives identical counts incl. benchmark_pairs and benchmark_annotations); Cohen's kappa stays realistic (~0.6, strictly between 0 and 1 - do NOT make annotator_a a perfect copy of gold); do NOT touch seed/fixtures/*.json held-out gold submissions or the temporal_bucket==1 _naturalistic_text phrasings (they must remain not-engineered around mock cues so the held-out eval stays honest and uncontaminated); pair count stays >= 300.

Part (b) verify: run the seed twice and confirm identical counts (benchmark_pairs 308, benchmark_annotations 616, plus institutions 3/users 4/official 120/submissions 65/merkle_roots 1/merkle_proofs 185/anchor_blocks 1); confirm kappa is still ~0.6 (0 < kappa < 1) via the harness and/or the reviewer kappa path; confirm both eval splits still exit 0 and the held-out temporal FinalSay F1 (~0.05) is unchanged (proving no contamination); update/confirm backend/finalsay/tests/test_seed.py still passes (adjust only if counts/structure legitimately changed, never to mask a regression).
acceptance_criteria: The Alerts page is either removed cleanly (page + route + nav link, build still green) or reduced to a clearly-labelled non-interactive placeholder with NO half-working interactive control.
Benchmark phrasings read less templated while generation stays deterministic and pure (no RNG).
Seed remains idempotent: two consecutive seeds produce identical counts (benchmark_pairs >= 300, kept at 308; benchmark_annotations 616; other counts unchanged).
Cohen's kappa stays realistic (~0.6, strictly 0 < kappa < 1) - not 1.0.
Held-out splits stay uncontaminated: seed/fixtures/*.json and temporal_bucket==1 naturalistic phrasings untouched; both eval splits exit 0 and held-out temporal FinalSay F1 is unchanged.
make test passes and npm run build is green.
verification: cd apps/web && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -5
cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m finalsay.eval.harness --split temporal; echo exit=$?
cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m finalsay.eval.harness --split institution; echo exit=$?
findings: Both parts done and verified. Part (a): chose PLACEHOLDER over removal. AlertsPage.tsx reduced to a non-interactive placeholder - removed localStorage subs state, subsKey() helper, toggle() handler, checkbox switches, and the subscription-filtered feed table; kept a clearly-labelled 'Not implemented in this prototype' note plus a read-only preview of the 10 latest official notices (real GET /api/notices data) explicitly marked as not a real alerts feature. Dropped now-unused imports (useMemo, useAuth). Route (App.tsx) and nav link (NavBar.tsx) left in place pointing at the honest placeholder - no dangling import/route/link, no unused vars. Part (b): diversified benchmark phrasing via a NEW pure/deterministic function benchmark_pair_phrasing(index, gold_label) in seed/dataset.py that rotates 15 topics, 6 issuer/institution combos, 7 date pairs, and 3 submission templates per gold label (+1 official template per label), indexed by co-prime offsets. Added two NULLABLE columns to BenchmarkPair (submission_text, official_text, models.py); _seed_benchmark fills/backfills them from the pure function; surfaced via BenchmarkPairOut (schemas.py) and the reviewer UI (types.ts + BenchmarkPage.tsx). NO notices added (submissions stay 65, official stay 120). Kappa is computed from annotator label columns, not phrasing, so it is unaffected. INTEGRITY CHECKS (measured, unchanged): seed idempotent - two consecutive runs identical: institutions 3, users 4, official_notices 120, submissions 65, notice_fields 925, benchmark_pairs 308, benchmark_annotations 616, merkle_roots 1, merkle_proofs 185, anchor_blocks 1. Cohen's kappa = 0.625 (0<k<1, unchanged, annotator_a NOT a copy of gold). Pair count 308 (>=300). Held-out uncontaminated: seed/fixtures/*.json and temporal_bucket==1 naturalistic phrasings untouched; held-out temporal FinalSay F1 = 0.048 (unchanged); both eval splits exit 0. test_seed.py NOT edited (count expectations 308/616 unchanged; new columns additive+nullable). docs/eval-results.md left as-is (kappa there already 0.625, unchanged). npm run build green; full suite 59 passed. NOTE: create_all does not ALTER an existing SQLite table, so a stale gitignored backend/finalsay.db from before the new columns must be deleted to re-seed (done during verification); pytest unaffected (fresh temp DB per run).
